name: Craftsman's Writ: Barbaric Gloves
summary: A transferable writ requests Barbaric Gloves and gives a delivery location and payment details. You need the writ with you to complete the transaction.

sections.title: A Customer's Request
sections.body: A customer requests one pair of Barbaric Gloves through this faded writ. The note gives a delivery location and payment details, and it can pass from hand to hand. You need the writ in your possession when you deliver the requested item.

faq.answer: The customer requests one pair of Barbaric Gloves.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the gloves?
faq.answer: The delivery location is marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: What does the writ say about payment?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment.
